title: hieracium subramosum subsp. basilare
intro: Hieracium subramosum subsp. basilare, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion-like family and has a unique appearance with bright yellow flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium subramosum subsp. basilare include antimicrobial and antifungal activities, which can aid in wound healing and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have potential applications in the development of new medicines.
